title: Machine learning identifies SIK1 as an epilepsy driver validated in rat models
summary: Machine learning on LKB1-pathway genes from public GEO data ranked SIK1 as the top epilepsy risk gene. In a PTZ status epilepticus rat model, SIK1 knockdown shortened seizure duration and overexpression worsened seizures, with patch-clamp and Western blot support. The abstract does not state how the ML ranking was itself tested beyond the public dataset.
ai_technology: Machine learning screening of LKB1 pathway genes on GEO dataset GSE143272
organization: The First People's Hospital of Qinzhou

evidence.tested: SIK1 knockdown and overexpression in vivo in a PTZ-induced rat model, with EEG, patch-clamp and Western blot readouts.
evidence.unknown: Not stated in the reviewed material
evidence.ai_role: Machine learning screened LKB1 pathway genes and ranked SIK1 as the top epilepsy risk gene for experimental follow-up.
